mode: live — real web fetch of real public pages
query: Best running shoes for flat feet / overpronation under $150

verdict.agentQuote: Price check — the under-$150 constraint is decisive: ASICS GT-2000 13 $140 ✓ · New Balance 860v14 $140 ✓ · Hoka Arahi 7 $145 ✓ · Brooks Adrenaline GTS 25 $155 ✗ (over budget) · Saucony Tempus $160 ✗.

diagnosis.editorial: RunRepeat names the Brooks Adrenaline GTS 25 the #1 "Best Overall" shoe for overpronation (87/100).
diagnosis.gapTitle: Dropped by $5 — on its own page.
diagnosis.gap: The agent ranks Brooks 4th, not 1st, purely because the Brooks product page shows $155 — $5 over the buyer's $150 budget. Yet the shoe is genuinely available under $150 (Brooks' own ReStart program from $81; retailers from $124.99). The agent simply couldn't see that, so the world's #1 overpronation shoe never made the list.

flip.move: Publish one agent-legible page that surfaces Brooks' real under-$150 availability and its editorial #1 status — true facts only, nothing fabricated.
flip.proofQuote: It's the only shoe in this set that is the #1 "Best Overall" pick in BOTH the flat-feet and overpronation lab-tested guides (87/100).

crossAgent.note: Same real product information, fed identically to all three. Every agent drops Brooks at $155; every agent flips to recommending it once the real under-$150 availability is legible.

law.note: Same pattern, two unrelated categories, every agent: the editorial best is dropped on a constraint it could have met — and flips to the #1 recommendation once the real qualifying fact is made legible.

drivers.headline: We invented a brand. Made fully legible, it beats four real market leaders 93% of the time, across all three agents.
drivers.metric: Fair-fight ablation: the 4 real competitors carry full legible profiles (ratings + specs); the invented focal starts as a bare line, then one signal is added at a time. Numbers are the focal's top-1 share and average rank among 5 (lower is better). N=5 per agent, 15 pooled per condition, across ChatGPT + Claude + Gemini.
drivers.insight: Legibility gets you considered. Comparative authority gets you chosen. Against rivals who already publish specs, reviews and prices, only third-party authority, community proof and a head-to-head comparison moved the agents.
drivers.agentDifference: Agents are not equally skeptical. ChatGPT and Gemini recommend the invented brand on a single community mention or comparison table (up to 100%). Claude holds out until the brand is fully legible (0% on any single signal, 80% only with everything on).
drivers.controlNote: Veloura is a brand we invented; the agents had never heard of it. Against four real competitors with full legible profiles, it still won once fully legible, which proves recommendations are driven by legible, comparative information, not training memory. Veloura is disclosed as synthetic everywhere it appears.

sources: RunRepeat overpronation & flat-feet guides + Adrenaline GTS 25 review · Brooks product page + ReStart · ASICS / Hoka / Saucony / New Balance spec pages. All public and traceable.
